observations: Two large black upright figures dominate the left and center, each marked with red X shapes over circular eye forms and jagged tooth rows outlined in white.
A cream and tan background is cut across by broad flat strokes of blue, with loose black lines running diagonally across the full width of the image.
The lower-right corner carries a small signature area with yellow scribble marks layered over it, distinguishing this image from its same-number variant, which lacks that yellow overlay.
reading: Two black figures, stacked and overlapping, carry repeated marks: crossed X eyes, ringed circles, and tooth-lined mouths. A smaller outlined figure sits between them, drawn in thin neon lines against the dark mass. The blue sweeps and scattered yellow zigzags push outward while the figures hold the center. The spiral forms at the right edge read as a quieter pull against the crowded interior.
